title: SqnPAN: analysis code, supplementary tables and glycan models for "Somatic loss of N-glycosylation sequons occurs at the rate expected from mutational processes across 33 tumour types"
description: Analysis code (Python and R), Supplementary Tables S1 to S40 and the Re-Glyco glycan models of Figure 7F for the article Somatic loss of N-glycosylation sequons occurs at the rate expected from mutational processes across 33 tumour types (A. Balasundar, 2026). Somatic missense mutations of 10,190 TCGA tumours of 33 cancer types are mapped to N-glycosylation sequons with experimental evidence, and sequon-destroying substitutions are compared with other N, S and T substitutions of the same proteins by a position-count test, a trinucleotide-context model and dNdScv against a pre-specified equivalence margin, with null and planted-effect controls. The scripts reproduce every result, table and figure of the article from the public files listed in data/README_data.md; each script header holds its dated pre-specification. See README.md for the run order.
